title: hypericum scabrum var. bourgaei
intro: Hypericum scabrum var. bourgaei, commonly known as the shrubby St. John's Wort, is a plant species within the Hypericum genus, known for its medicinal properties and traditional uses. The health benefits of Hypericum scabrum var. bourgaei include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and other mood disorders. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and hyperforin, which may exhibit neuroprotective, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Hypericum scabrum var. bourgaei include hyperforin, a naphthodianthrone responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as flavonoids such as quercetin and kaempferol, which contribute to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
